name: Slobad
description: A goblin who received the latent energies of the soul traps and gave up his spark to return Mirrodin's denizens.

description_citations.text: "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad remarks on the luck of Krark's Thumb.
timeline.quote: I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for.

citation.text: Krark's Thumb (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bruenna agrees to help Glissa, Slobad and Bosh reach the Pool of Knowledge.
timeline.quote: she agreed to assist them, motivated by the opportunity to undermine the Vedalken

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad relinquishes his spark, triggering the Vanishing and recovering the souls.
timeline.quote: those souls were recovered when Slobad relinquished his fresh spark

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat Karn melts him down, revealing the Mirari, left in the care of Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn returned to his plane and melted down Memnarch to his core, revealing the Mirari underneath.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core, triggering the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: The Fifth Dawn event would lead Glissa and Slobad to defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad is born under the Eye of Doom, a taboo meaning death, but his mother hides him in the air ducts.
timeline.quote: Slobad's mother did not follow tradition and instead hid the young goblin in the air ducts

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dwugget finds the infant Slobad and raises him in the Krark Cult.
timeline.quote: the infant goblin was found by another goblin by the name of Dwugget.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Leonin capture Slobad and make him a servant of their leader Raksha.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Leonin and turned into a servant

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad flees after a failed invention and finds the levelers' cavern.
timeline.quote: Slobad decided it was best to flee before any punishment could be forthcoming

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad helps the captured elf Glissa free herself and leads her to Taj-Nar to be healed.
timeline.quote: Slobad leads her back to Taj-Nar where the leonin could heal her wounds.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad repairs the golem Bosh, who joins Glissa and Slobad.
timeline.quote: introduced himself as Bosh

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group defeats the necromancer Geth at Ish Sah.
timeline.quote: ruled by the necromancer Geth

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group learns Memnarch is responsible for the attacks.
timeline.quote: The ancient and mythical being known as Memnarch was responsible for the attacks.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kaldra avatar betrays the group when Memnarch takes control of it.
timeline.quote: they were betrayed by the avatar when Memnarch gained control of it.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosh stays behind and gives his life so his friends can escape.
timeline.quote: Bosh stayed behind while the pair escaped, giving his life to spare his friends.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fifth Dawn is triggered and a new green sun is born.
timeline.quote: The Fifth Dawn was triggered, blasting the Kaldra Guardian away

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Viridian Elves arrest Glissa and Slobad for the murder of Glissa's parents.
timeline.quote: were immediately arrested by the Viridian Elves for the murder of Glissa's parents

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa falls into a trap at Ish-Sah, leaving Slobad alone.
timeline.quote: Glissa fell into a horrible trap

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch captures Slobad, tortures him, amputates his limbs and links him to a machine.
timeline.quote: Slobad was captured without much fight and Memnarch made plans to utilize the goblin's brilliance.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa knocks herself and Memnarch into the core and her spark transfers to Slobad.
timeline.quote: her spark was accidentally transferred to his battered form

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad meets Karn, the creator of Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: he came face to face with the planeswalker who had created Mirrodin itself: Karn

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad gives up the spark to resurrect the dead and send them home.
timeline.quote: the goblin gave up the spark to resurrect all the people killed on Mirrodin and send them home

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa meets the goblin Slobad in a cavern.
timeline.quote: introduces himself as the goblin Slobad

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Meeting Slobad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Taj-Nar Ushanti sees a vision of Glissa and Raksha sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.
timeline.quote: He cannot leave during the siege, but he sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "At Taj-Nar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad reactivate a golem and capture Yert, who agrees to lead them to Geth.
timeline.quote: She convinces Yert to take her to Geth by promising to get him a new reaper.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Mephidross and finding Bosh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bosh sacrifices himself to save his friends at the Krark-Clan hideout and is later partly reassembled by Slobad.
timeline.quote: Bosh himself is blown to pieces.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Krark-Clan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad rescue the cultists and Bosh from the Great Forge, finding the red lacuna.
timeline.quote: They rescue the cultists and learn that Bosh is with the refuse to be thrown into the furnace.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Krark-Clan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bruenna allies with Glissa against the aerophin and explains how the serum made the vedalken cruel.
timeline.quote: With her village under threat, Bruenna has little choice but to ally with Glissa.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "The Quicksilver Sea". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad and Bosh rescue Glissa, and the group descends below the Knowledge Pool to the blue lacuna as Glissa has a flare of Memnarch's mutation.
timeline.quote: the slow mutation of Memnarch from golem to monster

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Into the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa Sunseeker recalls Slobad as seemingly exiled for being too smart.
timeline.quote: I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart.

citation.text: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Slobad wonders what kind of ogre approaches.
timeline.quote: Is it the stomping kind or the munching kind?

citation.text: Drooling Ogre (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Slobad builds the Ascension Web for Memnarch; at the Vanishing the Panopticon is annihilated.
timeline.quote: Upon the Vanishing , the main structure of the Panopticon, as well as its reconstruction disk, was annihilated.

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cornered by Malil's threshers and levelers, Glissa channels green fire in an explosive burst that disables all pursuers.
timeline.quote: In a rage at what appears to be the end, Glissa channels her green fire again into an explosive burst that disables all their pursuers.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "In the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The sapient wolf Al-Hayat joins the group and helps rescue Slobad.
timeline.quote: He agrees to join the group, and together they rescue Slobad.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Meeting Al-Hayat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marek captures Glissa, but a standoff between Pontifex and Malil lets her escape and find the Kaldra shield.
timeline.quote: Glissa is taken captive by Marek, but Malil suddenly arrives with levelers in tow.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The Vault of Whispers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad survive the blast, as do Memnarch and Malil.
timeline.quote: Slobad hobbles up to her, scorched and bruised but otherwise intact.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Bosh and Slobad journey to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch.
timeline.quote: journey deep within Mirrodin's core to confront the insidious Memnarch

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch seizes the Kaldra avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.
timeline.quote: Memnarch seizes the avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh resist Memnarch and confront him in the Core, where he channels the plane's mana through the Panopticon.
timeline.quote: Their resistance culminated in a confrontation deep within Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
timeline.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves who blame Glissa for vanishing kin.
timeline.quote: Glissa and Slobad were captured by Viridian elves

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns to brute force, trapping Glissa in a temporal bubble for five years and altering his devices to use souls as power.
timeline.quote: Memnarch trapped her for five years in a temporal bubble.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa wakes, rallies survivors and assaults Memnarch's stronghold, throwing herself at him as the spark device activates so both fall into the mana core.
timeline.quote: together, they both fell into the raw mana core of Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The spark transfers to Slobad; upon Memnarch's death Karn returns.
timeline.quote: Upon Memnarch's death, Karn could finally return to his plane.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn restores the souls, causing the Vanishing, destroys Memnarch's body and gives the Mirari to Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn destroyed Memnarch's body, recovering the Mirari

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa kills Memnarch, destroying the soul traps.
timeline.quote: When Glissa eventually killed Memnarch, all the existing soul traps on the plane were destroyed, killing everyone instantly

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn restores the dead and triggers the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: This triggered the Vanishing , wherein the kidnapped inhabitants were returned to their long-forgotten homes.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves, learn Lyese is alive, and are tried by a tribunal that acquits Glissa; Lyese attacks and all three fall.
timeline.quote: The council quickly decides that Glissa is not guilty, but Lyese takes her acquittal poorly and attacks.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "After the Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the green lacuna Malil stabs Glissa and Slobad is taken.
timeline.quote: Malil taunts her, revealing Memnarch has a new plan that involves the goblin tinkerer - before running Glissa through.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Confrontation with Malil". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch has Malil mutilate Slobad and takes over his torture to build a means to take Glissa's spark.
timeline.quote: Then Memnarch takes over Slobad's torture.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "New and old enemies". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad finishes a plane-wide network for spark transference while his own mind begins to reassert itself.
timeline.quote: Slobad is putting the finishing touches on a plane-wide network for spark transference.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Slobad's work". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raksha is killed, everyone dies, and the souls, mana and Glissa's spark enter Slobad, who ascends.
timeline.quote: Slobad ascends , and his body is restored.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Slobad that saving his friends would cost both of them the spark; Slobad agrees.
timeline.quote: Slobad surprises him by stating he doesn't care about the multiverse

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The return of Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa finds her home a charnel house, is wounded and captured by levelers, and is freed by Slobad.
timeline.quote: she found it a charnel house with levelers milling about.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa befriends Kha Raksha at Taj-Nar and travels through the Mephidross with Slobad and Bosh, defeating Geth.
timeline.quote: After defeating him, she struck a deal to spare him for information

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa is trapped in a time-bubble for five years, then dives to the core and finds Memnarch's spark-transfer machine with a tortured Slobad.
timeline.quote: she found Slobad strapped to the machine, horribly tortured, and used to engineer it.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa knocks Memnarch into the core; her spark transfers to Slobad, who relinquishes it, triggering the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: Slobad willingly relinquished his newfound spark and powers to save his friend, Glissa

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Glissa, Slobad and Geth as the new guardians of Mirrodin and the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Karn left Glissa, Slobad, and Geth as the new guardians of Argentum (Mirrodin) and the Mirari .

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Slobad is thought killed by panicked goblins, then compleated by Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
